market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $85 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI traded as low as $88.71 intraday on May 7, currently $93-100. Hitting $85 LOW in May requires only a small further decline (~4-9%) from intraday low. With Iran de-escalation pushing oil down sharply (-9% session), $85 is highly likely to be touched.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether the downward momentum reverses sharply
